cards.name: Dealer Principal
cards.description: Select one of your active deals. It delivers immediately and cannot be sabotaged.
cards.flavor: "I've made my decision."

cards.name: Manufacturer Audit
cards.description: May only be played in response to Dealer Principal. Cancels it.
cards.flavor: "We have concerns."

cards.name: First-Time Buyer
cards.description: +2 with Base Model Sedan or BMW X1.
cards.flavor: Has 47 browser tabs of payment calculators open.

cards.name: College Graduate
cards.description: Factory Incentive attached to this deal grants +2 extra.
cards.flavor: The diploma is real. The credit history is brief.

cards.name: Family of Five
cards.description: +6 with BMW X5, +4 with BMW X3.
cards.flavor: Needs cupholders. So many cupholders.

cards.name: Empty Nester
cards.description: +3 with MINI Cooper or BMW M2.
cards.flavor: The kids are gone. The fun begins.

cards.name: Lease Return Customer
cards.description: +4 with any BMW vehicle.
cards.flavor: Third lease. Knows the finance office better than you do.

cards.name: BMW Enthusiast
cards.description: +8 with BMW M3, +6 with BMW M2, +3 with BMW 330i.
cards.flavor: Will explain the difference between an E46 and an E90. At length.

cards.name: MINI Fanatic
cards.description: +8 with MINI Cooper.
cards.flavor: Already named the car. It's Nigel.

cards.name: Business Owner
cards.description: +6 with BMW iX, +5 with BMW X5.
cards.flavor: "Can I write this off?" Yes. Probably. Ask your accountant.

cards.name: Out-of-State Buyer
cards.description: +3 with any vehicle.
cards.flavor: High value, high hassle, six hours of paperwork.

cards.name: Referral Customer
cards.description: +3 with any vehicle.
cards.flavor: "Stan sent me." Everyone loves Stan.

cards.name: Corporate Fleet Buyer
cards.description: +4 with any vehicle.
cards.flavor: Buys in bulk. Negotiates in bulk too.

cards.name: Luxury Shopper
cards.description: +10 with Unicorn Allocation.
cards.flavor: Asked if it comes in a color that doesn't exist yet.

cards.name: Dream Customer
cards.description: +5 with any vehicle. Cannot be stolen or ghosted.
cards.flavor: Pays sticker. Brings donuts. Leaves a 5-star review.

cards.name: High Mileage Trade
cards.description: Gains +5 if the deal employee is the Used Car Manager.
cards.flavor: The check engine light is just ambiance.

cards.name: Service Loaner
cards.description: A gently used bargain with full service history.
cards.flavor: Only driven to the dealership and back. Repeatedly.

cards.name: Base Model Sedan
cards.description: +2 with First-Time Buyer.
cards.flavor: Crank windows build character.

cards.name: Certified Pre-Owned
cards.description: Safe, flexible inventory.
cards.flavor: 172-point inspection. Point 173 is vibes.

cards.name: MINI Cooper
cards.description: +8 with MINI Fanatic, +3 with Empty Nester.
cards.flavor: Small car. Big personality. Enormous options list.

cards.name: BMW X1
cards.description: +2 with First-Time Buyer.
cards.flavor: The gateway crossover.

cards.name: BMW 330i
cards.description: +3 with BMW Enthusiast.
cards.flavor: The benchmark. Ask any car magazine since 1982.

cards.name: BMW X3
cards.description: +4 with Family of Five.
cards.flavor: High-demand inventory. Don't sit on it.

cards.name: BMW X5
cards.description: +6 with Family of Five, +5 with Business Owner.
cards.flavor: The boss of the school pickup line.

cards.name: BMW iX
cards.description: +6 with Business Owner.
cards.flavor: The grille is a conversation starter. Every time.

cards.name: BMW M2
cards.description: +6 with BMW Enthusiast, +3 with Empty Nester.
cards.flavor: Comes with a manual. The salesperson cried a little.

cards.name: BMW M3
cards.description: +8 with BMW Enthusiast.
cards.flavor: Sold before it left the truck.

cards.name: Unicorn Allocation
cards.description: +10 with Luxury Shopper.
cards.flavor: One allocation. Four GMs fighting over it.

cards.name: New Hire
cards.description: +1 to the deal they work.
cards.flavor: Day three. Still looking for the dealer trades department.

cards.name: Porter
cards.description: Draw 1 extra card when played.
cards.flavor: Knows where every key in the building is. Allegedly.

cards.name: Receptionist
cards.description: Protects this deal's Client from being stolen or ghosted.
cards.flavor: Screens your calls. Screens your customers' cold feet too.

cards.name: BDC Agent
cards.description: When played, search the deck for the next Client and add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: Sixty calls a day. Two appointments. One show.

cards.name: Product Genius
cards.description: +2 if the deal vehicle is a BMW.
cards.flavor: Knows every menu in iDrive. Even the secret ones.

cards.name: Finance Coordinator
cards.description: +1 to the deal they work.
cards.flavor: Has a stamp for everything.

cards.name: Service Advisor
cards.description: Your team gains +1 profit whenever any Event card is played while this Advisor works an active deal.
cards.flavor: "While we're in there, you might as well..."

cards.name: Client Advisor
cards.description: +2 to the deal they work.
cards.flavor: Closes with a handshake and a free keychain.

cards.name: F&I Manager
cards.description: +3 to the deal they work.
cards.flavor: Nobody escapes without hearing about the extended warranty.

cards.name: Used Car Manager
cards.description: High Mileage Trade in this deal gains +5.
cards.flavor: Can appraise a car from across the parking lot. In the rain.

cards.name: Sales Manager
cards.description: Protects this deal's Vehicle from sabotage.
cards.flavor: "Let me go talk to my manager." He IS the manager.

cards.name: GSM
cards.description: Blocks any sabotage card targeting this deal.
cards.flavor: Walks the tower. Sees everything.

cards.name: Superstar Employee
cards.description: +1 to the deal. Blocks the first sabotage card that targets this deal.
cards.flavor: Salesperson of the month. Every month. It's getting weird.

cards.name: Bad Survey
cards.description: Target team loses 5 profit.
cards.flavor: "Completely satisfied" or you've failed. There is no 9.

cards.name: Chargeback
cards.description: Opponent loses half the profit of their most recent delivered deal (minimum 5).
cards.flavor: The money flies backwards. Physics weeps.

cards.name: Factory Incentive
cards.description: Attach to one of your deals. +5 profit. +2 extra with College Graduate.
cards.flavor: Free money from the mothership.

cards.name: Recall Campaign
cards.description: Every opponent active deal's vehicle loses 2 value. Protected vehicles are unaffected.
cards.flavor: Please return your vehicle. And your weekend plans.

cards.name: Employee Quits
cards.description: Remove the Employee from a target opponent deal. The deal stops pending.
cards.flavor: Took the cardboard box. Left the demo keys.

cards.name: Massive Trade
cards.description: Reveal cards from the deck until you find 3 Vehicles. Keep them, discard the rest.
cards.flavor: A whole fleet rolled in on one title.

cards.name: Viral Social Post
cards.description: Your team gains 5 profit immediately.
cards.flavor: The dancing porter video hit 2 million views.

cards.name: Internet Lead Ghosts You
cards.description: Destroy a target opponent deal by discarding its Client. Blocked if the Client is protected.
cards.flavor: "Is this still available?" ...hello? Hello?

cards.name: Google Review Hero
cards.description: Attach to one of your deals. +3 profit on delivery.
cards.flavor: Five stars. Named the whole staff. Spelled every name right.

cards.name: End-of-Month Rush
cards.description: Deliver one of your pending deals immediately.
cards.flavor: It's the 31st. Nobody goes home.

cards.name: Another Dealer Called
cards.description: Steal the Client from a target opponent deal. It joins one of your building deals or your hand.
cards.flavor: "They said they can beat your price by $50."

cards.name: Customer For Life
cards.description: Attach to one of your deals. After delivery, the Client returns to the owner's hand.
cards.flavor: Buys a car every two years. Sends a holiday card.

cards.name: Record Month
cards.description: Your team gains 10 profit immediately.
cards.flavor: The banner is already at the printer.
